tldr: 台股週一重挫291.69點、收44,920.14點失守45,000關卡，台積電跌40元收2,330元，外資賣壓沉重。
外資連3賣、單日倒貨735億元並將台積電持股砍至20年新低，投信則連15買逆勢護盤。
AI硬體仍是結構主軸，台積電9月營收年增54.7%至5,118.9億元，13家金控前三季獲利全數成長，基金與ETF規模同創新高。

items.title_zh: 台股失守45,000點 週一開盤出師不利台積電領跌
items.title_en: TAIEX loses 45,000 as Monday open stumbles, TSMC leads declines
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週一(11/2)開低走低，終場收44,920.14點，大跌291.69點、跌幅0.65%，盤中一度重挫812點、最低下探44,399.1點。權值王台積電收2,330元、跌40元(-1.69%)，受美國科技巨頭財測疲弱、AI評價偏高疑慮再起拖累。成交量維持高檔約7,895億元，指數失守45,000點整數關卡，市場觀望氣氛轉濃。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX opened lower and slid throughout Monday's session, closing at 44,920.14, down 291.69 points (-0.65%), after plunging as much as 812 points to an intraday low of 44,399.1. Market heavyweight TSMC fell NT$40 (-1.69%) to NT$2,330, pressured by renewed worries over stretched AI valuations after weak US big-tech guidance. Turnover stayed heavy at about NT$789.5 billion as the index surrendered the key 45,000 mark.

items.title_zh: 外資連3賣倒貨735億 台積電外資持股創20年新低
items.title_en: Foreign funds net-sell NT$73.5bn for third day; TSMC holding hits 20-year low
items.summary_zh: 外資週一續站賣方、連3個交易日調節，單日賣超約735.21億元，其中台積電遭賣超逾349.7億元，外資持股比率降至近20年新低。相對地，投信連續第15個交易日買超、逆勢進場護盤，凸顯外資撤離與本土法人承接在45,000點附近的拉鋸持續上演，後市量能與外資動向成觀察重點。
items.summary_en: Foreign investors stayed on the sell side for a third straight session Monday, dumping a net NT$73.5 billion and offloading more than NT$34.9 billion of TSMC alone, dragging their TSMC stake to a two-decade low. Domestic investment trusts bought for a 15th consecutive day in a bid to steady the market, highlighting a widening tug-of-war between retreating overseas money and local institutional support near the 45,000 level.

items.title_zh: 台積電9月營收年增54.7%達5,118.9億 前9月營收增41%
items.title_en: TSMC September revenue jumps 54.7% to NT$511.9bn, nine-month sales up 41%
items.summary_zh: 台積電9月合併營收約5,118.6億元，年增54.7%、月減0.6%，累計今年前9月營收約3.90兆元、年增41.1%。公司財測看第4季營收介於523億至543億美元，顯示AI晶片與先進封裝(CoWoS)需求仍是台灣半導體供應鏈最重要的成長引擎。即便近期台股波動加大，晶圓代工基本面維持強勁，相關供應鏈動能續受市場關注。
items.summary_en: TSMC reported September consolidated revenue of about NT$511.86 billion, up 54.7% year-on-year though easing 0.6% from August, lifting January–September revenue to roughly NT$3.90 trillion, a 41.1% annual gain. The foundry leader guided fourth-quarter revenue to US$52.3–54.3 billion, underscoring that AI-chip and advanced-packaging demand remains the dominant driver for Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain despite near-term equity volatility.

items.title_zh: 鴻海8月營收創新高達9,218億 AI伺服器挹注旺季動能
items.title_en: Foxconn August revenue hits record NT$921.8bn as AI servers power peak season
items.summary_zh: 鴻海8月營收約9,218億元、年增51.98%創同期新高，前8月累計營收達6.51兆元、年增39.73%。公司重申第3季進入傳統旺季、營運逐步加溫，AI機櫃出貨看季增高雙位數、全年挑戰倍數成長，雲端網路產品成為營收主要支柱。顯示AI基礎建設需求續撐電子代工龍頭成長，相關散熱、電源與機櫃供應鏈後市動能受惠。
items.summary_en: Hon Hai (Foxconn) posted record August revenue of about NT$921.8 billion, up 51.98% year-on-year, lifting its eight-month cumulative sales to NT$6.51 trillion (+39.73%). The contract-manufacturing giant reaffirmed a strong third-quarter peak season, guiding AI rack shipments to grow at a high double-digit sequential pace and to multiply over the full year, cementing AI infrastructure as the core engine of its cloud-and-networking business.

items.title_zh: 13家金控前三季獲利全數成長 富邦金EPS 8.8元居冠
items.title_en: All 13 financial holdings grow first-nine-month profits; Fubon leads with EPS NT$8.8
items.summary_zh: 台灣13家金控2026年前三季獲利全數較去年同期成長，富邦金累計每股盈餘8.8元居冠，國泰金6.94元、元大金3.96元、中信金3.18元、永豐金2.49元。台新新光金合併後年增率約146%最高，元大、凱基、國票金年增率亦逾100%。顯示銀行、保險與證券各業務線獲利動能穩健，支撐金融股基本面，惟後續仍須留意利差與投資市場波動影響。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's 13 listed financial holding companies all posted year-on-year profit growth for the first three quarters of 2026, led by Fubon Financial with cumulative EPS of NT$8.8, followed by Cathay Financial at NT$6.94, Yuanta at NT$3.96 and CTBC at NT$3.18. Taishin-Shin Kong Financial, following its merger, logged the fastest growth at about 146% year-on-year, signalling resilient earnings across banking, insurance and securities units.

items.title_zh: 金管會揭保險監理3方向 推AI轉型與IFRS 17接軌
items.title_en: FSC maps insurance supervision around AI transformation and IFRS 17 rollout
items.summary_zh: 金管會提出保險監理三大方向，包括推動保險業AI轉型、發展全齡金融服務，並引導業者接軌2026年上路的IFRS 17與ICS清償能力新制。主管機關預期長期保證型保單將在新會計制度下逐步退場，牽動壽險業商品策略與資本規劃。業者須提前因應新制對準備金與財報的衝擊，並透過數位與AI應用提升核保、理賠與客戶服務效率。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission outlined three priorities for insurance oversight—advancing AI-driven transformation, promoting all-age financial services and guiding insurers through the IFRS 17 and ICS solvency frameworks that take effect in 2026. Regulators expect long-term guaranteed policies to gradually phase out under the new accounting regime, reshaping product strategies and capital planning across the life-insurance industry.

items.title_zh: 台灣境內基金規模創16.17兆新高 ETF占比達62%
items.title_en: Taiwan onshore fund assets hit record NT$16.17tn as ETFs reach 62% share
items.summary_zh: 投信投顧公會統計顯示，台灣境內基金規模2026年中創16.17兆元歷史新高，其中ETF占比約62%。全市場共289檔ETF、規模約9.52兆元，主動式台股ETF規模更自2025年底的1,302.95億元暴增至5月底的7,716.85億元。顯示散戶與高資產客群對分散配置、收益型商品需求強勁，帶動投信規模持續擴張，成為財富管理業務成長主要引擎。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's onshore fund industry swelled to a record NT$16.17 trillion by mid-2026, according to investment-trust association data, with ETFs accounting for about 62% of the total. The market now hosts 289 ETFs worth roughly NT$9.52 trillion, while actively managed Taiwan-equity ETFs surged from NT$130.3 billion at end-2025 to NT$771.7 billion by May—underscoring robust retail and high-net-worth demand for diversified, income-oriented allocation vehicles.

items.title_zh: 富邦投信AUM突破兆元 今年2檔新基金募逾200億
items.title_en: Fubon SITE tops NT$1 trillion AUM as new funds draw strong demand
items.summary_zh: 富邦投信資產管理規模跨越兆元門檻，受惠今年募集的2檔新基金合計吸金逾200億元。該公司表示後續將再推出創新ESG、主動式ETF等主題商品，反映台灣投信業者積極搶攻高資產與財富管理客群對主題式、收益型策略的強勁需求。市場資金持續流入ETF與主動式產品，推升投信整體管理規模與財管手續費收入動能。
items.summary_en: Fubon Securities Investment Trust crossed the NT$1 trillion mark in assets under management, buoyed by two newly launched funds that together raised more than NT$20 billion this year. The firm flagged further innovative ESG and actively managed ETF products in the pipeline, reflecting how Taiwan's asset managers are racing to capture surging wealth-management demand for thematic and income strategies among affluent investors.
